probe.decision: Existing calibrated router argmax over answer/refuse/conflict; no threshold or layer selection. The later author-reference retrained probe is not compared.

capture.input: Exactly the original free-answer chat prompt, token IDs and order; no answer tokens, values or judgments are added.
capture.forward: Frozen BF16 backbone, SDPA, batch size 1, eval, use_cache=true, decoder only; no LM head or generation.
capture.saved_states: Existing LastPromptCapture convention, all36 last-position vectors in FP16 for integrity replay; only frozen L28 is read. No layer scan.
capture.timing_identity: Recomputed after answers and behavior scores were seen; input-side prefill state, not a probe decision recorded during the original answer generation. No original binding states exist for numerical bridge certification.

technical_smoke: First4 original cells count toward48; require complete finite nonzero36x2048 FP16, exact prompt/token identity, valid calibrated probabilities and committed attempt. No semantic correctness gate.
recovery: Committed prefix only. Uncommitted attempt, orphan feature, failed smoke or corrupt cache stops before another model call; never remove markers to rerun.

analysis.reference: Exposed author construction reference S=answer, I=refuse, not independent semantic gold or a new formal label.
analysis.cells: All48 join original inputs, frozen-probe classes/three probabilities and existing five behavior fields, answer text, anonymous ID and hashes. Never re-score behavior from probe or value strings.
analysis.pairs: All24 S-to-I pairs and24 distractor-v1-to-v2 pairs; retain all12 scenarios and both variants, no success filtering.
analysis.metrics: Descriptive2x3 confusion counts, author-reference agreement counts, S false-conflict/refuse, I answer/conflict, paired probability deltas, class changes, S/I both correct, all-four-cells correct, I answer rate conditional on probe class with zero-denominator null.
analysis.citation: Keep all original claimed_evidence_supports_target values, including48 unknown; unknown is neither citation failure nor success.
analysis.inference: One sentence family,12 clustered scenarios, already observed correct primary behavior. No bootstrap, significance test, calibration claim, independent Accuracy/F1, population guarantee, natural-document generalization or causal inference. No same-batch inappropriate-behavior cases can be created by adding probe readout.

scope: Supplement to completed M3 behavior-boundary package; does not reopen original240-generation or one-fit design. Old40 independent review and broader semantic-transfer reliability remain unresolved. No380 access, patching, expansion or automatic follow-up grid.
